jobs.title: Automation Specialist
jobs.description:
Bracco is an international Group active in the healthcare sector and a leader in diagnostic imaging. The Group’s main products are contrast agents sold in over 100 countries, both directly and indirectly through branches, joint ventures and license and distribution agreements.

Our Geneva manufacturing site operates in a highly regulated pharmaceutical environment and is inspected by major regulatory authorities, including the FDA and Swissmedic. The site manufactures a lyophilized contrast agent that is exported to several countries worldwide.
To strengthen our Geneva team, we are looking for an:

Automation Specialist

Your mission

Ensure the availability, reliability, performance and compliance of computerized production systems, industrial automation platforms and production networks.

As the site’s automation and computerized systems expert, you will provide technical support to operations, lead and contribute to technical improvement projects, and support the continuous development of industrial digitalization solutions within a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment.

Reporting to the Maintenance & Engineering Manager, you will be responsible for the following activities:

Your responsibilities

• Manage and maintain computerized systems in accordance with GMP guidelines

• Administer the site’s industrial IT and production networks

• Ensure the administration and lifecycle management of production equipment computerized systems

• Review audit trails and support compliance activities

• Lead and participate in IT, automation and industrial digitalization projects

• Maintain technical documentation and quality procedures related to computerized systems and networks

• Act as the local technical interface with corporate IT, telecom and automation stakeholders

• Provide expertise on PLCs, servers, vision systems, printing systems and industrial software platforms

• Manage maintenance contracts related to computerized systems.

Your Qualifications & Skills

• Degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or a related field

• Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated environment, such as the chemical or microelectronics industry

• Strong knowledge of industrial automation systems, including Siemens S7 PLCs, TIA Portal and SCADA systems (iFIX/FIX32)

• Familiarity with industrial IT infrastructure, including networks, Windows domains, servers and VMware environments

• A rigorous, quality-driven and compliance-oriented mindset

• A proactive attitude, flexibility and strong teamwork skills

• Good command of French and English; Italian is an asset.

We offer

• The opportunity to join a well-established and successful company with bright prospects and state-of-the-art manufacturing sites and production facilities

• A great development perspective and the opportunity to bring and utilize your know-how and expertise

• Competitive remuneration packages as well as first class benefits complete this offer

If you are passionate about automation technologies and enjoy working in a regulated industrial environment where quality, reliability and innovation are essential, we look forward to receiving your application.

Contract type:
Permanent
If you meet the requirements of this opportunity and would like to join an international group working to improve patients' lives, apply now!
At Bracco, we believe in the values of diversity and inclusion. We respect and celebrate the diversity of our people and their experiences, ensuring a fair opportunity for all.
We are #Bracco #JoinUs

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bracco è un Gruppo internazionale attivo nel settore sanitario e leader nella diagnostica dell'imaging. I principali prodotti del Gruppo sono agenti di contrasto venduti in oltre 100 paesi, sia direttamente che indirettamente attraverso filiali, joint venture e accordi di licenza e distribuzione.

Il nostro sito di produzione di Ginevra opera in un ambiente farmaceutico altamente regolamentato ed è ispezionato da importanti autorità di regolamentazione, tra cui la FDA e Swissmedic. Il sito produce un agente di contrasto liofilizzato che viene esportato in diversi paesi in tutto il mondo.
Per rafforzare il nostro team di Ginevra, stiamo cercando un:

Specialista di automazione

La tua missione

Assicurare la disponibilità, l'affidabilità, le prestazioni e la conformità di sistemi di produzione informatizzati, piattaforme di automazione industriale e reti di produzione.

Come esperto di automazione e sistemi informatizzati del sito, fornirete supporto tecnico alle operazioni, portare e contribuire a progetti di miglioramento tecnico, e sostenere lo sviluppo continuo di soluzioni di digitalizzazione industriale all'interno di un ambiente di produzione farmaceutica.

Segnalando al Responsabile Manutenzione e Ingegneria, sarai responsabile delle seguenti attività:

Le tue responsabilità

• Gestione e manutenzione di sistemi informatizzati secondo le linee guida GMP

• Amministrare le reti industriali IT e di produzione del sito

• Assicurare l'amministrazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita degli impianti di produzione sistemi informatici

• Verificare i percorsi di audit e sostenere le attività di conformità

• Piombo e partecipazione a progetti IT, automazione e digitalizzazione industriale

• Mantenere la documentazione tecnica e le procedure di qualità relative a sistemi e reti informatizzate

• Agire come interfaccia tecnica locale con gli stakeholder aziendali IT, telecomunicazioni e automazione

• Fornire competenze su PLC, server, sistemi di visione, sistemi di stampa e piattaforme software industriali

• Gestisci i contratti di manutenzione relativi ai sistemi informatici.

Le tue qualifiche e competenze

• Laurea in Ingegneria dell'automazione, Ingegneria elettrica o elettronica, o un campo relativo

• Esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica o in un altro ambiente altamente regolamentato, come l'industria chimica o microelettronica

• Forte conoscenza dei sistemi di automazione industriale, inclusi i sistemi Siemens S7 PLC, TIA Portal e SCADA (iFIX/FIX32)

• Familiarità con l'infrastruttura IT industriale, tra cui reti, domini Windows, server e ambienti VMware

• Una mentalità rigorosa, orientata alla qualità e alla conformità

• Un atteggiamento proattivo, flessibilità e forti capacità di lavoro di squadra

• Buon comando di francese e inglese; italiano è un bene.

Offriamo

• L'opportunità di unire una società consolidata e di successo con prospettive brillanti e siti produttivi all'avanguardia e strutture produttive

• Una grande prospettiva di sviluppo e l'opportunità di portare e utilizzare il vostro know-how e competenza

• Pacchetti di remunerazione competitivi e benefici di prima classe completano questa offerta

Se siete appassionati di tecnologie di automazione e godere di lavorare in un ambiente industriale regolamentato in cui la qualità, l'affidabilità e l'innovazione sono essenziali, non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione.

Tipo di contratto:
Permanente
Se si soddisfano i requisiti di questa opportunità e si desidera unire un gruppo internazionale che lavora per migliorare la vita dei pazienti, applicare ora!
A Bracco, crediamo nei valori della diversità e dell'inclusione. Rispettiamo e celebriamo la diversità della nostra gente e le loro esperienze, garantendo una giusta opportunità per tutti.
Siamo #Bracco #JoinUs

Unser Genfer Produktionsstandort ist in einem stark regulierten pharmazeutischen Umfeld tätig und wird von den wichtigsten Aufsichtsbehörden, einschließlich der FDA und Swissmedic, kontrolliert. Die Website stellt ein lyophilisiertes Kontrastmittel her, das in mehrere Länder weltweit exportiert wird.

Automatisierungsspezialist

Als Experte für Automatisierungs- und Computersysteme bieten Sie technische Unterstützung für den Betrieb, leiten und tragen zu technischen Verbesserungsprojekten bei und unterstützen die kontinuierliche Entwicklung industrieller Digitalisierungslösungen in einer pharmazeutischen Fertigungsumgebung.

Berichterstattung an den Maintenance & Engineering Manager, werden Sie für die folgenden Aktivitäten verantwortlich sein:

Ihre Verantwortung

• Verwalten und pflegen Sie computergestützte Systeme gemäß den GMP-Richtlinien

• Verwaltung der industriellen IT- und Produktionsnetzwerke des Standorts

• Gewährleistung der Verwaltung und des Lebenszyklusmanagements von computergestützten Produktionsanlagen

• Überprüfung von Audit-Trails und Unterstützung von Compliance-Aktivitäten

• Führen und beteiligen Sie sich an IT-, Automatisierungs- und industriellen Digitalisierungsprojekten

• Pflegen Sie die technische Dokumentation und die Qualitätsverfahren in Bezug auf computergestützte Systeme und Netzwerke

• Handeln Sie als lokale technische Schnittstelle zu den Stakeholdern der Unternehmens-IT, Telekommunikation und Automatisierung

• Bereitstellung von Fachwissen zu SPSs, Servern, Bildverarbeitungssystemen, Drucksystemen und industriellen Softwareplattformen

• Verwalten Sie Wartungsverträge im Zusammenhang mit computerisierten Systemen.

Ihre Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten

• Abschluss in Automatisierungstechnik, Elektro- oder Elektroniktechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Erfahrung in der Pharmaindustrie oder einem anderen stark regulierten Umfeld wie der Chemie- oder Mikroelektronikindustrie

• Starkes Wissen über industrielle Automatisierungssysteme, darunter Siemens S7 SPS, TIA Portal und SCADA Systeme (iFIX/FIX32)

• Vertrautheit mit der industriellen IT-Infrastruktur, einschließlich Netzwerken, Windows-Domänen, Servern und VMware-Umgebungen

• Eine strenge, qualitätsorientierte und compliance-orientierte Denkweise

• Eine proaktive Einstellung, Flexibilität und starke Teamfähigkeit

• Gute Beherrschung von Französisch und Englisch; Italienisch ist ein Asset.

Wir bieten

• Die Möglichkeit, einem etablierten und erfolgreichen Unternehmen mit guten Perspektiven und hochmodernen Produktionsstätten und Produktionsstätten beizutreten

• Eine großartige Entwicklungsperspektive und die Möglichkeit, Ihr Know-how und Fachwissen einzubringen und zu nutzen

• Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütungspakete sowie erstklassige Leistungen runden dieses Angebot ab

Wenn Sie sich für Automatisierungstechnologien begeistern und gerne in einem regulierten industriellen Umfeld arbeiten, in dem Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit und Innovation unerlässlich sind, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bracco est un groupe international actif dans le secteur de la santé et un leader en imagerie diagnostique. Les principaux produits du Groupe sont des agents de contraste vendus dans plus de 100 pays, tant directement que indirectement par le biais de succursales, de coentreprises et d'accords de licence et de distribution.

Notre site de fabrication genevoise fonctionne dans un environnement pharmaceutique hautement réglementé et est inspecté par les principales autorités réglementaires, dont la FDA et Swissmedic. Le site fabrique un agent de contraste lyophilisé qui est exporté vers plusieurs pays du monde entier.
Pour renforcer notre équipe de Genève, nous recherchons :

Spécialiste de l'automatisation

Votre mission

Assurer la disponibilité, la fiabilité, la performance et la conformité des systèmes de production informatisés, des plates-formes d'automatisation industrielle et des réseaux de production.

En tant qu'expert en automatisation et systèmes informatisés du site, vous fournirez un soutien technique aux opérations, dirigerez et contribuerez à des projets d'amélioration technique, et soutenirez le développement continu de solutions de numérisation industrielle dans un environnement de fabrication pharmaceutique.

Sous l'autorité du gestionnaire de la maintenance et de l'ingénierie, vous serez responsable des activités suivantes :

Vos responsabilités

• Gérer et entretenir les systèmes informatisés conformément aux lignes directrices sur les BPF

• Administrer le site des réseaux industriels d'informatique et de production

• Assurer l'administration et la gestion du cycle de vie des systèmes informatisés d'équipement de production

• Examiner les pistes de vérification et appuyer les activités de conformité

• Diriger et participer à des projets de TI, d'automatisation et de numérisation industrielle

• Tenir à jour la documentation technique et les procédures de qualité relatives aux systèmes et réseaux informatisés

• Agir en tant qu'interface technique locale avec les acteurs de l'informatique, des télécommunications et de l'automatisation

• Fournir une expertise sur les PLC, serveurs, systèmes de vision, systèmes d'impression et plateformes logicielles industrielles

• Gérer les contrats de maintenance liés aux systèmes informatisés.

Vos qualifications et compétences

• Diplôme en génie de l'automatisation, en génie électrique ou électronique ou dans un domaine connexe

• Expérience de l'industrie pharmaceutique ou d'un autre environnement hautement réglementé, comme l'industrie chimique ou la microélectronique

• Bonne connaissance des systèmes d'automatisation industrielle, y compris Siemens S7 PLC, TIA Portal et SCADA (iFIX/FIX32)

• Familiarité avec l'infrastructure informatique industrielle, y compris les réseaux, les domaines Windows, les serveurs et les environnements VMware

• Un état d'esprit rigoureux, axé sur la qualité et axé sur la conformité

• Une attitude proactive, une flexibilité et de solides compétences en travail d'équipe

• Bonne maîtrise du français et de l'anglais; l'italien est un atout.

Nous offrons

• L'occasion de rejoindre une entreprise bien établie et prospère avec de belles perspectives et des sites de fabrication et des installations de production à la fine pointe de la technologie

• Une grande perspective de développement et l'occasion d'apporter et d'utiliser votre savoir-faire et votre expertise

• Les forfaits de rémunération concurrentiels ainsi que les avantages de première catégorie complètent cette offre

Si vous êtes passionné par les technologies d'automatisation et que vous aimez travailler dans un environnement industriel réglementé où la qualité, la fiabilité et l'innovation sont essentielles, nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre application.

Type de contrat :
Permanent
Si vous répondez aux exigences de cette opportunité et que vous souhaitez vous joindre à un groupe international qui travaille pour améliorer la vie des patients, faites votre demande dès maintenant!
Chez Bracco, nous croyons aux valeurs de diversité et d'inclusion. Nous respectons et célébrons la diversité de nos peuples et de leurs expériences, en assurant une occasion équitable pour tous.
Nous sommes #Bracco #Jouer

jobs.title: Internship: Robotic Solution for Test Automation of a Contrast Media Injector
jobs.description:
Bracco is an international Group active in the healthcare sector and a leader in diagnostic imaging. The Group’s main products are contrast agents sold in over 100 countries, both directly and indirectly through branches, joint ventures and license and distribution agreements.

Research and Development (R&D) encompasses a wide range of roles focused on the innovation, development, and enhancement of products, technologies, and processes. Professionals in this field work to transform scientific knowledge into practical applications, ensuring that the organization's offerings are at the forefront of the industry. This job family is essential for driving growth, maintaining competitiveness, and addressing emerging market needs.Background and Motivation
Contrast media injectors are safety-critical medical devices used in CT and MRI imaging. Verification of their performance is essential but remains largely manual, making testing time-consuming and prone to variability.

A robotic test system is already implemented and operational. The next step is to expand its capabilities: enabling it to autonomously execute test protocols, increase flexibility. This project focuses on advancing the existing robotic platform into an intelligent and configurable test automation system for contrast media injectors.

Objectives

• Program the existing robotic system to autonomously execute structured test protocols.

• Develop a flexible software framework to configure and run different test sequences.

• Expand the robot’s capabilities to cover additional test scenarios and edge cases.

• Quantify efficiency gains and reproducibility compared to manual testing.

Contract type:
Internship

La ricerca e lo sviluppo (R&D) comprende una vasta gamma di ruoli focalizzati sull'innovazione, lo sviluppo e la valorizzazione di prodotti, tecnologie e processi. Gli iniettori multimediali a contrasto sono dispositivi medici critici per la sicurezza utilizzati nell'imaging CT e MRI. La verifica delle loro prestazioni è essenziale ma rimane in gran parte manuale, facendo test che richiedono tempo e inclini alla variabilità.

Un sistema di test robotico è già implementato e operativo. Il passo successivo è quello di espandere le sue capacità: consentendole di eseguire autonomamente protocolli di prova, aumentare la flessibilità. Questo progetto si concentra sull'avanzare la piattaforma robotica esistente in un sistema di automazione di test intelligente e configurabile per gli iniettori dei media di contrasto.

Obiettivi

• Programmare il sistema robotico esistente per eseguire autonomamente protocolli di prova strutturati.

• Sviluppare un framework software flessibile per configurare ed eseguire diverse sequenze di test.

• Espandi le capacità del robot per coprire ulteriori scenari di prova e casi di bordo.

• Quantifica i guadagni di efficienza e la riproducibilità rispetto ai test manuali.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bracco est un groupe international actif dans le secteur de la santé et un leader en imagerie diagnostique. Les principaux produits du Groupe sont des agents de contraste vendus dans plus de 100 pays, tant directement que indirectement par le biais de succursales, de coentreprises et d'accords de licence et de distribution.

La recherche-développement (R-D) englobe une vaste gamme de rôles axés sur l'innovation, le développement et l'amélioration des produits, des technologies et des processus. Les professionnels de ce domaine travaillent à transformer les connaissances scientifiques en applications pratiques, en veillant à ce que les offres de l'organisation soient à la pointe de l'industrie. Cette famille d'emplois est essentielle pour stimuler la croissance, maintenir la compétitivité et répondre aux besoins du marché émergent. Contexte et motivation
Les injecteurs de médias contrastés sont des dispositifs médicaux critiques pour la sécurité utilisés dans l'imagerie par TDM et par IRM. La vérification de leurs performances est essentielle, mais demeure en grande partie manuelle, ce qui rend les essais longs et sujets à la variabilité.

Un système de test robotique est déjà mis en place et opérationnel. La prochaine étape consiste à développer ses capacités : lui permettre d'exécuter de manière autonome des protocoles d'essai, accroître sa flexibilité. Ce projet vise à faire de la plateforme robotique existante un système d'automatisation de test intelligent et configurable pour les injecteurs de médias contrastés.

Objectifs

• Programmer le système robotique existant pour exécuter de façon autonome des protocoles d'essai structurés.

• Développer un cadre logiciel flexible pour configurer et exécuter différentes séquences de test.

• Développer les capacités du robot pour couvrir des scénarios de test supplémentaires et des cas de bord.

• Quantifier les gains d'efficacité et la reproductibilité par rapport aux essais manuels.

jobs.title: Digital Learning & Training Internship
jobs.description:
Bracco is an international Group active in the healthcare sector and a leader in diagnostic imaging. The Group’s main products are contrast agents sold in over 100 countries, both directly and indirectly through branches, joint ventures and license and distribution agreements.

We are looking for a proactive and digitally minded intern to join our Global Customer Education & Training team. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the development and management of Bracco's global learning ecosystem, supporting both internal and external education initiatives.
The intern will work closely with international stakeholders to enhance digital learning experiences, optimize training platforms, and support the creation of engaging educational content for employees, customers, and healthcare professionals worldwide.
Key Responsibilities

• Support the continuous improvement and harmonization of WebCampus, Bracco's global Learning Management System (LMS).

• Contribute to the design and implementation of the new LMS homepage, coordinating with global stakeholders to ensure content consistency and user engagement.

• Support the harmonization of training curricula and learning pathways across global business functions and product areas.

• Assist in the deployment and adoption of onboarding and learning frameworks within the LMS environment.

• Support the management and evolution of Bracco Global Academy, Bracco's external educational platform dedicated to healthcare professionals and customers.

• Help organize and maintain educational content, learning journeys, and digital resources for global audiences.

• Support the production and editing of educational videos using digital platforms such as Vimeo and other multimedia tools.

• Support sales force readiness initiatives, including projects for international markets

• Assist with the coordination of global training initiatives and educational campaigns.

• Monitor platform usage and adoption metrics, helping identify opportunities to enhance learner engagement and training effectiveness.

Your Profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in education, digital learning, communications, marketing, business, a scientific discipline, or a related field.

• Strong interest in digital learning technologies, AI, e-learning platforms, and content creation.

• Organizational and project management skills.

• Excellent communication skills in English.

• Proactive mindset, curiosity, and willingness to work in an international environment.

What We Offer

• Exposure to international learning and development projects.

• Collaboration with cross-functional global teams across regions and business functions.

• Opportunity to contribute to the digital transformation of education within a global healthcare company.

• Development of skills in LMS administration, digital content creation and project management.

• Exposure to global training and educational platforms.

• Expense reimbursement and Meal vouchers

Contract type:
Internship
If you meet the requirements of this opportunity and would like to join an international group working to improve patients' lives, apply now!
At Bracco, we believe in the values of diversity and inclusion. We respect and celebrate the diversity of our people and their experiences, ensuring a fair opportunity for all.
We are #Bracco #JoinUs

jobs.description:
Bracco is an international Group active in the healthcare sector and a leader in diagnostic imaging. The Group’s main products are contrast agents sold in over 100 countries, both directly and indirectly through branches, joint ventures and license and distribution agreements.

About the Role:
We are looking for a Medical Device Specialist to support the development of our ACIST Medical devices (Injector, IVUS and FFR) business across all of Switzerland. In this field-based role, you will combine commercial, clinical, and technical expertise to promote innovative medical devices and support healthcare professionals in optimizing their use.
You will work closely with Cardiologists, nurses, biomedical engineers, and hospital decision-makers, providing product demonstrations, application support, training, and commercial guidance.
Key Activities
Sales & Business Development

• Promote Bracco Diagnostic Imaging systems and related medical devices

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with hospitals, clinics, and healthcare professionals

• Identify customer needs and propose tailored solutions

• Negotiate and support equipment sales opportunities

• Monitor market trends and competitor activities within the assigned territory

• Develop and execute territory action plans aligned with company objectives.

Clinical & Application Support

• Provide product demonstrations and application training to healthcare professionals

• Explain product features, benefits, and clinical applications

• Support customers during installations and implementation phases

• Ensure optimal utilization of Bracco Medical Devices

• Deliver scientific, technical, and product-related information to customers.

Territory & Customer Management

• Maintain accurate customer records and activity reports using Salesforce.com

• Ensure regular follow-up of the installed equipment base

• Collaborate closely with Marketing, Sales, and Technical Service teams

• Participate in scientific meetings, congresses, and customer events

• Manage territory activities in compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.

Education and Prior Experience

• Degree in Biomedical Engineering, Radiology Technology, Cardiology (Cath Lab), Life Sciences, or equivalent experience

• Experience in medical device sales, applications, or clinical support preferred

• Knowledge of Cardiology workflows and diagnostic imaging environments is an advantage

• Strong communication and presentation skills

• Commercial mindset combined with customer-focused approach

• Ability to work independently and manage territory effectively

• Good computer skills, including MS Office and CRM systems.

Languages

• German: fluent (mandatory)

• English: required

• French: an advantage
